_comment: Derived by 2_configs/src/engines/derive-build-workflows.ts from 1_workflows/build.json. Do not edit — edit the source.
name: 1_workflows
runners_doc: Runner-image registry: arch -> {type, host?, builder_image?}. Migrated from the legacy runners.json that lived under I_cloud-data/ (Step 3, 2026-05-09 — now z_archive). Consumed by 1_workflows/src/scripts/cloud-ship-container-step-build-docker.sh and cloud-ship-ci-builder-dispatch.sh via 2_configs/dist/build-workflows.json (symlinked from 1_workflows/src/build-workflows.json). 2_configs/build.sh aggregates this build.json's runners + probe + dispatch fields into dist/build-workflows.json. amd64 = local build on the x86 GHA runner (ubuntu-latest). arm64 = local build on the native GHA arm64 runner (ubuntu-24.04-arm) — the Ship job's runs-on is selected per-VM-arch in .github/workflows/ship.yml (detect job derives runner from .vms[].specs.arch), so both arches build natively on the arch-matching hosted runner with NO QEMU and NO SSH dispatch. Migrated 2026-08-07 off the oci-apps ssh cloud-builder-x runner (cold arm64 builds exceeded the ship clock on the cacheless, disk-pressured VM). The ssh runner-type path and .probe/.dispatch tunables remain in the engine for any future remote-builder arch but are currently unused. Probe retry/backoff lets the engine survive transient SSH timeouts on any ssh-type runner (WG flap, sshd MaxStartups burst).
dispatch_doc: Async build dispatch: engine writes the docker-run command to a remote script, launches it via nohup (detached from the SSH session), and polls a status file. Survives WG flaps / sshd restarts during long builds — the build keeps running on the runner; the engine just reconnects to read status.
